name: isLinkBrandingValid
definition: True when the email service has at least one branded link domain and every branded domain has a valid record, so tracked links in mail point at the company's own domain instead of a shared service address.
population: the branded link domains in one email-service account; denominator = every domain the read lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the account's link branding records showing every domain valid; a cut-off, error, 401/403 or unrecognised read is Not evaluated. An empty list is a real read of no branding and is False.
citations: SendGrid API reference, Link Branding (twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/link-branding): GET /v3/whitelabel/links returns valid and the dns records per domain

changeLog.change: Registered so the SendGrid email-security transformations can emit it. Meaning written from the public SendGrid API reference and one read of a real account (read-only); no replay-backed validation yet, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Judges the service's own report that the DNS records resolve (valid). Stale invalid duplicates beside a valid record are a finding. Messaging Security is allowed too because the SendGrid integration is catalogued under communication (Messaging Security).
